pairs.difference: Both whistles float on flat yellow fields with widely spaced, tone-on-tone campfire motifs. Neither backdrop adds competing props.
Both horns float against turquoise radial fields. The backgrounds contain no scenery or secondary props.
A has a bright orange-red gradient; B has a darker red gradient. Both keep the space around the cup and saucer empty.
Both baskets stand on plain yellow surfaces against purple backdrops. Neither introduces extra scenery or props.
A has a solid wooden deck wall behind the barrel; B has a low open railing. Both use a quiet blue backdrop and simple wooden surroundings.
Both taxis stand on simple roads with broad white markings, backed by blue radial fields. Neither adds traffic or roadside scenery.
A surrounds the tent with broad tree shapes and open grass. B adds a lantern on foreground rocks, visible bedding, prominent rope stakes, scattered flowers and diagonal sunbeams.
pairs.fix: Place the tent in a quiet forest clearing with a few large trees and broad grass patches. Remove the lantern, foreground rocks, visible bedding, scattered flowers and sunbeams.

pairs.difference: A places the hanging pot above a simple log fire with trees behind. B adds a vegetable crate at left, a garnished stump at right, a large stone fire ring and many small ground details.
pairs.fix: Hang the pot over a small log fire on a broad patch of bare earth. Use a few large forest shapes behind it. Remove the vegetable crate, stump, stone ring and scattered ground decorations.

pattern: Generated environments accumulate supporting props and small accents around the hero. The clearest tells are crowded foreground corners and elaborate fire or campsite arrangements; the real examples leave broader, quieter surroundings.
